run_interactive_retrieval: run the interactive TART retrieval system to search passages and retrieve top-k documents for a query
rerank_documents_with_cross_encoder: rerank retrieved documents using a cross-encoder model like T5 to improve relevance scores
embed_queries_with_contriever: embed query text into vector embeddings using a Contriever model for dense retrieval
index_passage_embeddings: index pre-computed passage embeddings into a FAISS index for fast nearest neighbor search
retrieve_and_score_passages: retrieve top-k passages for a query and add them to results with relevance scores
